learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with specific tools for Project Management in the field of Planning and Cost Management.

Validate acquired skills in Planning and Cost Management through two Project Management specialty certifications (Planning and Cost Management) issued by the French Society for the Advancement of Project Management and accredited by the International Cost Engineering Council.

syllabus_topics: Project analysis and design of its execution
Creating the schedule and determining project duration
Operational monitoring, deadline control, main causes of delay
Objectives and concepts of cost management
Project cost baseline: establishment and evolution
Operational monitoring, cost control, main sources of overrun
assessment_rules: Two tests allow obtaining the Project Management specialty certifications (Planning and Cost Management). The individual evaluation consists of EVI 1 (coefficient 1) and EVI 2 (coefficient 0.5).
bibliography: Conduite de projet : la planification, Marcel Minana, Afnor
Techniques de planification de projets, Gilles Vallet, Dunod
Maitrisez le coût de vos projets. Manuel de coûtenance, Michel Joly, Jean Le Bissonnais, Jean-Louis G. Muller, Afnor
Gérer un projet gagnant ! Manuel de coûtenance, Jean Le Bissonnais, Michel Joly, Jean-Louis G. Muller, Afnor
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
